tpms.when: 2015 (indirect system with a TPMS button; calibrate after any pressure change, tire rotation or new tire)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the driver's door jamb sticker.
Bring the vehicle to a complete stop and turn the ignition to ON (on smart-entry models, use the ENGINE START/STOP button).
Press and hold the TPMS button until the low tire pressure/TPMS light blinks a few times. That means calibration has started.
If the light does not blink, calibration did not start. Press and hold the button again.
tpms.note: Do this every time you adjust a tire's pressure, rotate the tires, or replace a tire. If you can't find the TPMS button, check the tire pressure monitoring section of your owner's manual.
